//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the timeline CONTAINER. See ../README.md + button.json/card.json for the model. SCOPE: this slice tests ONLY the timeline container contract — its tag, its pa-timeline / pa-timeline--* block classes (variant + alternating layout modifiers), and its class passthrough. The item area is filled with a plain slot-text token (the dumpers HTML-escape slot text, so real child markup cannot be fed through a slot). Per-item structure (pa-timeline__item + markers/connectors, __time/__date/__icon/__content/__avatar/__comment/__date-header/__date-icon/__date-label, and the __scroll-container/__loader/__load-more-wrapper utilities) is a DEFERRED sub-slice with its own timeline_item fixture later — exactly like tooltip deferred its JS bubble. Those classes are listed under `deferred` below so they are explicitly labelled, not silently swallowed; none are block (pa-timeline--*) modifiers so capability.mjs axis-1 (block-modifier-scoped reverse check) does not false-fail on them.

propsVocabulary.alignment: alternating-only layout modifier: force all items to start or end side (start|end); omit to zig-zag
propsVocabulary.keepLayout: boolean — alternating-only: keep desktop zig-zag on mobile (no single-column collapse below the breakpoint)
propsVocabulary.singleColumn: boolean — alternating-only: force single-column layout at any width (pa-timeline--single-column)
propsVocabulary.body: item area content — a plain text token in this container slice (items are the deferred sub-slice)

goldenConventions: The container is a <ul> in EVERY scenario. The core snippet's canonical timelines use <ul>/<li> (simple/feed/alternating, snippet lines 22-159) and note that <div> works identically because the SCSS keys off :nth-child, not the tag; <ul> is the blessed container tag (semantic list of events). The base pa-timeline class carries no visual styling on its own — pick ONE variant. Slot content is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the wrapper's container tag + classes + passthrough, not rich item content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away by the comparator.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. Only the 7 pa-timeline--* BLOCK modifiers are container features. capability.mjs axis-1 reverse-check is block-modifier-scoped, so the item-level pa-timeline__* classes (see `deferred`) are neither required here nor flagged.

body.note: structural — item area; a plain text token in this container slice
